D-10.title: Authorise mutable tool actions
D-10.default: Default to Gateway-enforced action authorisation with a signed, scoped receipt and idempotency key before every external mutation.

D-14.title: Reconcile semantic identities
D-14.default: Default to canonical IDs with source lineage and explicit unresolved-conflict states; never silently choose the newest record as truth.

D-18.title: Prove Gateway non-bypassability
D-18.default: Default to mandatory PEP checks on mutable external actions, enforced by credentials, routing policy and egress controls.
